global_caption: The video contains 9 shots and is a suspenseful narrative short film set in an underwater courtroom, rendered in a cool-toned watercolor picture book style. The overall palette features blue-gray and teal-green hues. The entire sequence uses Chinese Lighting relies primarily on natural diffused light from the seabed and cold overhead and side lighting within the courtroom. The emotional tone remains tense and oppressive throughout, shifting to relief at the conclusion.

A judge fish enters from the lower left of the frame, trailing small bubbles from its tail fin. Cold natural diffused light covers the stone steps outside the museum.
